mapper.select:
SELECT ml.user_id AS lawyerId, m.name AS lawyerName, ml.firm_name AS firmName, CONCAT_WS(' ', ml.sido, ml.sigungu, ml.region_detail) AS region, ml.experience_years AS experienceYears, ml.specialty AS specialty FROM member_lawyers ml JOIN member m ON ml.user_id = m.user_id WHERE m.deleted = 1
AND ml.specialty LIKE CONCAT('%', #{specialty}, '%')
AND ml.sido = #{sido}
ORDER BY ml.experience_years DESC, m.name ASC

SELECT ml.user_id AS lawyerId, m.name AS lawyerName, ml.firm_name AS firmName, CONCAT_WS(' ', ml.sido, ml.sigungu, ml.region_detail) AS region, ml.experience_years AS experienceYears, ml.specialty AS specialty, m.email AS email, m.phone AS phone FROM member_lawyers ml JOIN member m ON ml.user_id = m.user_id WHERE ml.user_id = #{lawyerId} AND m.deleted = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `match` ( user_id, title, content, price, status, match_type ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{price}, 'PENDING', 'DIRECT' )
INSERT INTO match_bid ( match_id, lawyer_id, bid_price, status, message ) VALUES ( #{matchId}, #{request.lawyerId}, #{request.price}, 'PENDING', NULL )
INSERT INTO match_file ( match_id, original_name, saved_name, file_path, file_size, file_type ) VALUES ( #{matchId}, #{originalName}, #{savedName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{fileType} )
mapper.select: SELECT id AS fileId, original_name AS originalName, file_size AS fileSize, file_type AS fileType, CONCAT('/api/requestlist/requests/', match_id, '/files/', id, '/download') AS downloadUrl FROM match_file WHERE match_id = #{matchId} AND deleted = 1 ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT mt.id AS matchId, mt.user_id AS userId, requester.name AS requesterName, mb.lawyer_id AS lawyerId, lawyer.name AS lawyerName, ml.firm_name AS firmName, mt.title AS title, mt.content AS content, mt.price AS price, mt.status AS matchStatus, mb.status AS requestStatus, mt.created_at AS createdAt FROM `match` mt JOIN member requester ON mt.user_id = requester.user_id JOIN match_bid mb ON mt.id = mb.match_id JOIN member lawyer ON mb.lawyer_id = lawyer.user_id JOIN member_lawyers ml ON mb.lawyer_id = ml.user_id WHERE mt.id = #{matchId} AND mt.match_type = 'DIRECT' AND mt.deleted = 1 AND mb.deleted = 1 ORDER BY mb.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT mt.id AS matchId, mb.lawyer_id AS lawyerId, lawyer.name AS lawyerName, ml.firm_name AS firmName, mt.title AS title, mt.price AS price, mt.status AS matchStatus, mb.status AS requestStatus, mt.created_at AS createdAt FROM `match` mt JOIN match_bid mb ON mt.id = mb.match_id JOIN member lawyer ON mb.lawyer_id = lawyer.user_id JOIN member_lawyers ml ON mb.lawyer_id = ml.user_id WHERE mt.user_id = #{userId} AND mt.match_type = 'DIRECT' AND mt.deleted = 1 AND mb.deleted = 1 ORDER BY mt.created_at DESC

SELECT mt.id AS matchId, mt.user_id AS requesterId, requester.name AS requesterName, mt.title AS title, mt.content AS content, mt.price AS price, mt.status AS matchStatus, mb.status AS requestStatus, mt.created_at AS createdAt FROM match_bid mb JOIN `match` mt ON mb.match_id = mt.id JOIN member requester ON mt.user_id = requester.user_id WHERE mb.lawyer_id = #{lawyerId} AND mt.match_type = 'DIRECT' AND mt.deleted = 1 AND mb.deleted = 1 ORDER BY mt.created_at DESC

SELECT id AS fileId, match_id AS matchId, original_name AS originalName, saved_name AS savedName, file_path AS filePath, file_size AS fileSize, file_type AS fileType, created_at AS createdAt FROM match_file WHERE match_id = #{matchId} AND id = #{fileId} AND deleted = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE `match` SET status = 'CANCELED' WHERE id = #{matchId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND match_type = 'DIRECT' AND status = 'PENDING' AND deleted = 1
UPDATE match_bid SET status = 'CANCELED' WHERE match_id = #{matchId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND deleted = 1
